standard: landed-regions-standard-1018: local region trees, every cross-region net LANDED, per-region child-flop gate (TT and FF <= 80 ps); 1-bit reset runs are the only plain cross-region hops
window: (2 - 4) T + t_hold < dL < 2 T - t_cq - t_setup at TT and FF

reset.note: flat reference == landed parent with its reset delayed by depth; child c's reset run is depth + t(c)

compiler.note: every latency change vs the flat parent; the compiler schedule takes these (static calendar, no runtime flow control)

skipped_mutants.4: as rp4lp: every child's reset only clears valid flags or masks that random stimulus re-writes (lane masks reset to lane 0 and are re-loaded by any select beat); quiet_reset presents no data before release + offsets, so a child released one edge late is not observable. Landing reset alignment is covered by MUT 2.

die_obligations: drop one clock per region at the region's clock port (ck_<r>); each region builds its own local tree
communicating regions (landed pairs) need NO phase alignment inside the landing window at TT and FF
reset-hop pairs ['n-s']: region skew within about +/-400 ps at TT and FF (1-bit single-cycle hops)
boundary ports are timed against the region in port_regions / the record; die links into them land on THAT clock
